To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the general solution of the WZ consistency condition is obtained for Einstein gravity; (2) it is a sum of two terms, the first one being the standard one, and the second one being cohomologically trivial, i.e. the antifields occur in the WZ consistency only through cohomologuially trivial terms; (3) this second term is the one that allows for the introduction of the antifields in the WZ action.

the solution of the consistency condition of Einstein gravity in the space of forms is a linear combination of the forms that are obtained by taking the exterior derivative of any form in the space of fields, and by taking the interior product of any form in this space with a form of the space of ghosts, with coefficients that are functions of the fields, ghosts and antifields.

the general solution to the Wess-Zunino consistency condition in four-dimensional Einstein gravity can be expressed in the form of an arbitrary local form of ghost number zero, plus the cohomologically trivial part of an arbitrary local 2-form, plus the co-homologically trivial part of the BRST transformation of the 2-form, and that the antifield can only occur in the general solution through a co-homologically non-trivial part.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the general solution of the WZ consistency condition for Einstein theory, in a space involving all the fields of the theory, including ghosts, and their derivatives.
the construction of a cohomological theory for Einstein gravity, in the framework of Batalin-Vilkovisky formalism, and with its application to the construction of an effective action.
a systematic investigation of the Wess–Zumino consistency condition in the space of forms, in the spirit of the Batalin–Vilkovisky formalism.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Wess-Zunino consistency condition for the Einstein gravity theory is trivial.
, in the framework of the antifield formalism, the Wess-Zomino consistency condition is solved in a very simple and straightforward way.
the antifield formalism for the Wess-Zunino consistency condition is a trivial formalism.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Wess-Zunino consistency condition is solved in the same way as the classical equations of motion.
the general solution for the Wess-Zunino consistency condition in the case of Einstein gravity has been constructed.
the general solution of the WZ consistency condition for four dimensional Einstein gravity is given by a sum of a trivial term and of a non-trivial term.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Wess-Zunino consistency condition for gravity is much more complicated than the one for Yang-Mills theories.

the general solution of the WZ consistency condition for Einstein-Yang-Mills gravity can be obtained from that for Einstein gravity, by simply adding the WZ consistency conditions for the Yang-Mills theory and for the gravitational Chern-Simons term.
the general solution of the WZ consistency condition is a local expression, and therefore the WZ consistency conditions can be used in the framework of the BV formalism.
